summary.one_liner: Irvue is a macOS screensaver that displays images pulled from Unsplash.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short. It describes the project as a screensaver that shows images from Unsplash. Installation is described as downloading a .saver file, double-clicking it so it appears in System Preferences, registering an Unsplash app, and then setting an Unsplash App Id, an image source, and an update interval. The README does not detail the image sources or other options beyond these named settings.
use_cases: rotating Unsplash photos as a screensaver
decorative desktop wallpapers on a Mac
how_to_run: Double-click the .saver file so it appears in System Preferences
Set your Unsplash App Id, choose a source, and set the update duration
notable: Shows photos from Unsplash as a macOS screensaver
Configurable image source and update interval
Requires user's own Unsplash App Id
caveats: Requires registering an Unsplash app and supplying your own App Id
README is minimal and does not describe further features or limits
Listed as macOS-only by its context in an macOS apps list
